description: This file is a PHP source file that sets up dependency injection container configurations, loads PHP class files related to containers, and defines custom error handlers for an API in the SuiteCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: An instance of Slim's Container used for dependency injection within the API.

classes.name: Paths
classes.description: Utility class used to retrieve library and custom library paths for loading container files.

methods.name: notAllowedHandler
methods.description: Handles requests made to routes that are not allowed, returning a JSON error response.

methods.name: notFoundHandler
methods.description: Handles requests for resources that are not found, returning a JSON error response.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles general errors/exceptions, returning a JSON error response.

methods.name: phpErrorHandler
methods.description: Handles PHP runtime errors, returning a JSON error response.
